propositions: The documented curl command to install the commit-msg hook uses git rev-parse --git-path which resolves to shared hooks in the common git dir, silently overwriting the pre-commit wrapper and breaking Change-Id stamping for all worktrees on the host

Running the documented install from a linked worktree clobbers the shared commit-msg hook in the main checkout, destroying the pre-commit wrapper and leaving Change-Id stamping non-functional until make hooks is re-run

The bare curl install path and the pre-commit wrapper are in conflict: curl overwrites the pre-commit chain, pre-commit install can then overwrite the Gerrit stamper, both silently, with failure only surfacing at git push gerrit potentially in a different worktree

The fix consolidates install into one idempotent documented path (make hooks calling scripts/install-gerrit-hook.sh) that detects and preserves pre-commit wrappers by installing to commit-msg.legacy instead, validates payload contains Change-Id logic, and refuses unsafe overwrites
AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md must remove instructions to curl over git rev-parse --git-path hooks/commit-msg and instead direct to make hooks
